output:
**An open letter from Thandi about the Lindale Court fire**

To my friends, my neighbours, the Little Acorns families, and anyone who gets this forwarded,

I’m okay. I’m safe. That’s the first thing.

I’m writing this because my phone has been going mad since Saturday and I’m so tired. I can’t answer everyone one by one, and I don’t want to keep telling the story over and over. So this is the one proper letter. Please forward it to anyone who asks. If you’re getting this and you don’t know me, hello, I’m Thandi. I teach the Ladybirds, Grade 00, at Little Acorns Pre-Primary in Mowbray.

**What happened, short version**

A fire started in a ground-floor flat at Lindale Court on Station Road in Observatory, not my flat, at about 11:40pm on Saturday 7 November. I’m on the second floor, flat 12. All 14 flats got out. Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home. The fire department says it was probably an electrical fault and they’re still investigating. I’m not going to guess beyond that.

My flat has smoke and water damage everywhere, and the ceiling came down in the lounge. My landlord says nobody can go back in for at least six weeks. I grabbed my phone and Marmalade and nothing else. Marmalade hid under the car for two hours afterwards. She’s fine now. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can’t.

Our neighbour Uncle Faizel banged on every door on our floor in his vest and slippers. That’s how I woke up. I will never be able to thank him enough.

I’m staying at my sister’s in Rondebosch.

**The fundraiser, and a warning about a fake one**

My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page. I hate asking for help and honestly feel weird about the fundraiser, but Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it. So I’m accepting it.

The only official fundraiser is here: **backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

The target is R25,000. This morning it was at R11,400. If you can share the link, that helps as much as donating.

There is also a fake “Thandi Fire Relief” page on some other site, plus a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT to a Capitec account. That is not me and not ours. I’ve reported it. Please don’t send money to it. If you’ve already shared it, please delete it. If you’re not sure, use the BackaBuddy link above or ask Zinhle. Please pass this warning on too, especially in the school groups.

**What I actually need**

- Help with the deposit for a new place.
- School shoes and work clothes, size 6 / size 34.
- A laptop, if anyone has an old one that works. All my lesson planning was on mine.

**What I don’t need**

- More clothes in general. I already have too many, and I’ll pass extras on to the other flats.
- Food. My sister’s freezer is full.

**For the school parents**

The concert on 27 November is still happening. Please don’t worry. The Ladybirds will have crowns. All the stuff I took home to laminate for the concert is gone, the 22 crowns and the kids’ handprint banner, but we’ll sort it out. I’m back at school on Wednesday. Please don’t make a big thing of it in front of the kids. They don’t need the whole story. They just need their teacher to be okay.

I’m going to reply to comments slowly. Please don’t be offended if I don’t answer DMs. I’m not ignoring you. I’m just tired.

**Thank you**

People have been amazing. One of my kids’ moms left a bag of clothes at my sister’s gate at 7am on Sunday without even knocking. I cried. I’ve been crying at every message, honestly. I’m so grateful.

Please forward this letter to anyone who needs it. Thank you.

Thandi
